crown.note: the boulders behind the head: heave a little with each step and rock a few degrees

pauL.note: left shoulder plates: follow the arm at about a third of its swing

pauR.note: right shoulder plates: the same, opposite phase

armL.note: left shoulder: swings +-30 degrees with the step, rises for the blow

head.note: centre of the dome: sinks 2-4 units with each step, leans into the blow
